annotations.title: Batch txs into one EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls

description: Turn txs[] from one or more build tools (same sender, same chain: Polygon 0x89, Base 0x2105 or Ethereum 0x1) into one EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request (version 2.0.0, atomicRequired) for smart wallets, plus the wallet_getCapabilities check to run first. Local, no network. Every build tool already returns batch for its own txs; use this to combine builds (e.g. revoke + swap).

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

chainId.description: 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. All txs in one batch must share it.

to.description: Target (null = contract creation; cannot be batched).

name: blazar_batch_calls
